messages.text: I sign the same assignments: Spear Council and Vigil Council, requesting Relief and council Raid. Your definite cooperation and expectation of combat are understood. The Warrant should use Vigil, leaving Spear available for the local attack. Our council delegates now carry one agreed request.

reason: The disclosed link between completed Trade and the target changes my preferred military route from Campaign to Raid. The crown's offered reserve makes the accompanying relief credible, while legal council use avoids wasting Communities on a discipline breach. I accept this service bargain for the round. Its success will strengthen our claim to a durable institutional settlement; it does not constitute advance approval of any constitutional article.
